title: One typed evidence-record schema instead of fifteen
summary: OBS/CLM/FND/FAIL/SUC/HYP/EXP/EVC/EVS/EVR/DEC/REL/CAP/RAD/Q share schemas/evidence-record-v1 with typed links; IMP keeps schemas/improvement.schema.json and is linked by id. The research experiment schema remains the detailed design template for EXP records. Rejected: one schema per type (15 files, maintenance cost, no consumer yet).
